To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a two-dimensional liquid-liquid chromatography tandem mass spectroscopy method was developed and successfully validated for the determination and quantification of 370 pesticides and 18 pyrrollizidine alkaloids as well as 9 mycotoxines, 2 plant growth regulators and 2 tropane alkaloids in whole wheat grains (Triticum aestivum) and oats (Avena sativa).
the developed method was able to successfully validate 343 pesticides, 6 pyrrolizidines, 7 mycotoxines, mepiquat, chlormequate and the tropane alkalides atropine and scopalamine.
we developed a fast and reliable method for the determination of a large number of pesticides, myctoxins, tropane and pyrrolidine alkaloids as well as growth regulators in oats and wheat.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a method for the simultaneous determination of pesticides, pyrrolidine alkaloids, growth regulator, tropane alkaloid and mycotoxin residues in wheat grains and oats, respectively, which was successfully validated.

the development and validation of an LC-MS/ MS method that can be used for the determination of a wide range of pesticides, contaminants, plant growth regulators and tropane alkaloids in oats, whole wheat grains and other cereals.
the development of an online two-dimensional liquid chromatographic method for the analysis of a broad range of pesticides and contaminants in whole grain oats and wheat.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed method can be applied for the determination of pesticides and contaminants in oats and wheat.
the method presented here is suitable for routine analyses of the target compounds in oats and wheat grains.
the developed method is a robust, reliable and fast tool for routine analyses of pesticide residues in whole wheat grains as well as oats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the developed method is suitable for the simultaneous determination of a broad range of pesticides and contaminants in wheat and oats.
a two-dimensional LC-TOF-MS method can be successfully applied to the analysis of pesticides, myco-, pyrrolizine-, tropane- alkaloids and plant growth regulators in oats and wheat.

this method is able to analyze a large number of different pesticides, mycotoxic fungi metabolites, tropane alkaloid, plant growth regulators, and also pyrrolizidin alkaloids in a single analytical run.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed method allows for the analysis of the majority of pesticides, myco- and phytocontaminants in oats and wheat without the need for sample preparation.
a two-dimensional LC-ESI-MS/MS method is a promising approach for the analysis of a wide range of analytes in complex samples.
the developed method can be used for the determination of a broad range of pesticides and contaminants in wheat and oat grains with high sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy.
